note: Baylor County (TX) does not publish zoning districts as a queryable service. The county's only city with zoning, Seymour, publishes its zoning map only as a static PDF (2022) and its ordinance as a DOCX; no ArcGIS REST or GIS download found in searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the web. Unincorporated county land is not zoned by the county.
